facts.text: Matt and I are starting a podcast together.
The podcast is tentatively called "After the wire".
The podcast will interview early stage founders.
The podcast will focus on understanding the real challenges early stage founders face building their company.
The podcast will cover the ups and downs of founders' journeys.
The podcast will explore what founders are trying to build.
The podcast emphasizes substance and building rather than the hype of investing.
The podcast will initially use founders that Matt and I have invested in as guests.
The podcast will expand to other founders that Matt and I want to build relationships with.
The intended audience includes people in early stage tech.
The intended audience includes venture investors.
The intended audience includes people generally interested in startups.
I asked for 5-10 super unique and interesting questions to ask founders that aren't typically asked in tech podcasts.
I asked how to make the podcast unique.
I asked for other ideas to make the podcast stand out from the crowd.
I suggested having repeating segments like "science corder" or "recruiting frenzy" where each founder is asked the same question on each episode.
I suggested that over time the repeating segments could become a "bit" on the show.
I asked for potential fun, unique, interesting segments to incorporate into the podcast.
